content: There's a great new meetup at https://www.meetup.com/boston-web-dev-class/ that I checked out this week. Highly recommended!

Philip, thank you!
Edited: sorry I'm still learning zulip. Please delete this message if I don't figure out how to move it to the thread.
I went to this again after work today. @Dave Hanft since you expressed interest I told @Maria Dolgareva your story. I hope you can make it sometime!
@Dave Hanft (and others) if you're around tomorrow and like board games, please see this: #boston > 2025-07 meetup @ 💬 :smile:

Philip Durbin said:

Dave Hanft (and others) if you're around tomorrow and like board games, please see this: #boston > 2025-07 meetup @ 💬 :smile:

I’m out of town. Will make it to one of these soon though!

I went to this on Wednesday and had a good time. Usually, I just stay for a little while on my way home but this time I stayed until the end.

@Maria Dolgareva nicely introduces me as someone who runs an open source meetup.

This sometimes leads to someone asking what sort of projects we're working on and I'm glad that this time I was able to point to the "better porchfest" app @Dan created: #boston > Hack Meetup: Building a Better Porchfest Map :tada:

@Maria Dolgareva has hit the big time! https://www.cambridgema.gov/Departments/cambridgepubliclibrary/newsandannouncements/2026/03/copyoflibrarylaunchestechforallinitiative

I stopped by and the room was packed! Congrats!
@Philip Durbin thank you for your support! It was a challenge to onboard more people today.
I bet! I can't wait to hear more! It's quite a service you're providing for the community! Well done!
Wow! I stopped by yesterday and @Maria Dolgareva has a cart with all kinds of gear for outdoor hacking! Three tables, a tent, and 18 chairs! Two giant batteries! Extension cords! A wifi hotspot!
Philip it was nice having you yesterday! Happy to share the gear if you ever want to take your meetup outdoors :smiley:
I wanted an outdoor thing at Bow Market that one time but we ended up mostly indoors. Hard to find outlets.
Wow! Where can I find the schedule for these events/potentially help out/help teach web development?

Hi @Adrian! Yes, the schedule is on the site Philip linked - we meet every Monday and Wednesday from 5:30 to 8:00pm. Here's our Discord as well https://discord.gg/wAMEqRMbdm.

Extra hands are always welcome: just come by to any meetup (most people show up around 6pm). If the weather is good, we’ll meet outside this Wednesday.
